title: Framing a camera-walk print

documents.title: Print counter guide
documents.text:
A borderless print fills the paper by trimming the sides of the image if its shape differs from the paper. Choose Fit instead if you need to keep the whole picture. Fit may leave a white strip along two edges. We cannot trim those strips at the counter.

If a print will go behind a pre-cut mount, bring the mount or measure its opening before ordering. Part of the paper needs to sit behind the mount, so the paper must be larger than the opening.
documents.textZh:
若照片比例與紙張不同，滿版沖印會裁掉照片兩側以填滿紙張。如果要保留整張照片，請選「完整置入」。完整置入可能在兩側留白，櫃檯無法協助裁掉這些白邊。

若照片將放在預切卡紙後面，請帶卡紙來，或在下單前量出它的開口。部分相紙必須壓在卡紙後面，因此相紙一定要比開口大。

documents.title: Message from Leon
documents.text: I want to print my bridge photo. Please keep both ends of the bridge visible. White strips are fine; I can use the old mount from my desk. I thought its opening was 20 by 25 centimetres, but can you measure it before you order?
documents.textZh: 我想沖印橋的照片。請保留橋的兩端。白邊沒關係，我可以用桌上舊的卡紙。我原以為開口是 20×25 公分，但你能在下單前先量一下嗎？

documents.title: Shop assistant’s note
documents.text: I measured Leon’s mount: its opening is 18 by 24 centimetres. It did not need to be replaced. We offer 18 by 24 and 20 by 25 centimetre paper. The saved preview shows the bridge photo is wider in shape than either paper size.
documents.textZh: 我量了里昂的卡紙，開口是 18×24 公分，無須更換。我們提供 18×24 和 20×25 公分的相紙。儲存的預覽顯示，橋的照片比例比這兩種相紙都更寬。

DOCUMENT 1 — Print counter guide

A borderless print fills the paper by trimming the sides of the image if its shape differs from the paper. Choose Fit instead if you need to keep the whole picture. Fit may leave a white strip along two edges. We cannot trim those strips at the counter.

If a print will go behind a pre-cut mount, bring the mount or measure its opening before ordering. Part of the paper needs to sit behind the mount, so the paper must be larger than the opening.

DOCUMENT 2 — Message from Leon

I want to print my bridge photo. Please keep both ends of the bridge visible. White strips are fine; I can use the old mount from my desk. I thought its opening was 20 by 25 centimetres, but can you measure it before you order?

DOCUMENT 3 — Shop assistant’s note

I measured Leon’s mount: its opening is 18 by 24 centimetres. It did not need to be replaced. We offer 18 by 24 and 20 by 25 centimetre paper. The saved preview shows the bridge photo is wider in shape than either paper size.
passageZh:
文件 1｜沖印櫃檯須知

若照片比例與紙張不同，滿版沖印會裁掉照片兩側以填滿紙張。如果要保留整張照片，請選「完整置入」。完整置入可能在兩側留白，櫃檯無法協助裁掉這些白邊。

若照片將放在預切卡紙後面，請帶卡紙來，或在下單前量出它的開口。部分相紙必須壓在卡紙後面，因此相紙一定要比開口大。

文件 2｜里昂的訊息

我想沖印橋的照片。請保留橋的兩端。白邊沒關係，我可以用桌上舊的卡紙。我原以為開口是 20×25 公分，但你能在下單前先量一下嗎？

文件 3｜店員紀錄

我量了里昂的卡紙，開口是 18×24 公分，無須更換。我們提供 18×24 和 20×25 公分的相紙。儲存的預覽顯示，橋的照片比例比這兩種相紙都更寬。
